answer 1. Notes: I entered Fort Chalkmoth unseen via the yard trapdoor into the cellar guardroom. The cellar is a prison of the Toh-Reel-Ka, guarded by gaoler Tsleel-Vaku, who refused persuasion and my illusion. The inner door is locked and he has no key; Never-Writes-Twice keeps it (so she lied or hid it when she dismissed the fort). Hist sap jars tied with the knot of Jal-Veesa's tree-minder are stacked in the quartermaster store, in a fort with no Hist. Something moans behind the door. I did not kill the Sarpa raiders (captain Sakeeus-Wan offered 100 gold for that, still open) and did not pick the lock. 2. Next: go to Bell Station (boat from Lilmoth) for the divers who know the marked drowned tower. 3. Options: return to Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom about the key, or pick the cellar door later, or the raider bounty. 4. Unknown: who is held in the cellar and why they are fed sap; I still carry 1050 gold, the Seal recipe, and lockpicks x2.

answer Fort Chalkmoth: I got in unseen by the yard trapdoor. The cellar below the keep is the Toh-Reel-Ka prison. Gaoler Tsleel-Vaku would not be persuaded or charmed. He has no key, and Never-Writes-Twice holds it, so she misled me about the fort. Sap jars from Jal-Veesa tree-minder are stored in the quartermaster store, though the fort has no Hist. Something moans behind the inner door, and I do not know who. I did not pick the lock or kill the Sarpa raiders; Sakeeus-Wan still offers 100 gold for that. I carry about 1050 gold, 2 lockpicks, the Seal recipe, 3 paralysis poisons and a rapier. Next: Bell Station by boat from Lilmoth for the drowned tower, and later ask Never-Writes-Twice about the cellar key. Vanin the Collector is also digging ahead of us.
